Travel Trade Representation Companies in India

Travel trade representatives introduce suppliers to relevant buyers and follow up on opportunities within an agreed commercial mandate.

Explore topics

Put a market team behind your product

Ask providers which agency segments they cover and whether competing accounts are excluded. Review a sample pipeline showing the progression from buyer meeting to first booking.

What should a travel trade representative report?

Ask for qualified buyer meetings, quotes, first bookings and repeat production, together with a named owner for each open opportunity.
